name: list_devices
summary: List devices: every one in the world, or those on a gateway's data networks; filter by prefab_hash or name_contains. Reference ids are strings. Lists 25 by default. Read only.

help.text: Each device comes with its reference id (a string), prefab and name. The reply lists the first 25; truncated gives the total and list_limits {devices: n} keeps more.

name_contains.description: Part of the device's name, any case.
